text: {"lessons":["I sold several positions after gains; before selling, I should weigh the reason to keep holding, not just the pleasure of locking in a profit.","I bought Stock B back at a higher price, so I should set clear reasons and limits for any repurchase instead of chasing a stock I sold.","Most months I made no trades while my account value rose overall; I should remember that staying put can be a sound decision, not a missed opportunity."]}
